Will you join them in this never-ending competition to please the Gods? Control unique warriors and battle your friends in fast-paced dynamic games in which your strategy makes all the difference! This explosive game combines tactical combat and area control. Charge head first or devise a trap to catch your opponent? Crush your enemies using sheer strength or control glyphs on the map to score a strategic victory? You must choose... or maybe try both at once! [Rating: 1/10] It is an illogic form to continue making damage to the principal game, Krosmaster Arena, which needs all the support and effort this game will take like always

[Rating: 4.5/10] Generally not worth the time investment. If you're going to go through all of the trouble to set up a Krosmaster game, you might as well play the longer and more complicated version

[Rating: 5/10] No plans for previous krosmaster characters cards brings this down for all our group. Otherwise a good game.

[Rating: 5/10] (BGA) The movement doesn't really matter beyond the initial approach. Deal damage, blink, and it's over.

[Rating: 5/10] Well, the game has too many expansions with too few new content, so I decided to stop collecting.

[Rating: 6/10] This edition is basically the same as 2.0, with some minor changes that allows for more balance than the original version. The miniatures are superb and the idea of upgrading your characters is cool. There is also plenty of variety.  However, the rules remain clunky and the combat, although better than before, still isn't my cup of tea. There are too many different powers and abilities that are not clear in the rules.
